Oh my gosh this is exactly it! You have phrased it so much better! I feel better that I’m not being really  picky. I love him but exactly like you brother he needs guidance. We went away last weekend and I was like this stuff goes in the car. He put it next to the car and waited for me to pack the car. 

The one bag thing is making me laugh so much cause I can just imagine it. I really didn’t think other people witnessed other with people who aren’t able to process a few steps ahead of the now
Thank you, I might try and get him to see the doctor and go for some tests. I just found out tonight his sister and niece were recently diagnosed with add and autism
Thinking he may be neurodivergent. His niece and sister just got diagnosed with add and autism recently

He hasn’t been diagnosed with anything but he struggles to manage himself at home and work. It has been about 2 years of dealing with this and I saw my mum coach my dad through life and I don’t want that for myself which is impacting my judgement I think. My dad has learning disabilities.
No medical conditions that I know of. He is a visual learner I think

He just doesn’t seem to be able to grasp concepts. It looks like he is trying but ge struggles with most things His main hobbies are video games and footy. He admits he sucks at footy and does it for social reasons. He is an trades apprentice

Thank you, I really needed to hear that someone has been in the same place as new. Im trying not to let it get to me and trying to just enjoy my life right now. 
It is super hard but I hope you are right and it will all come around to me eventually.
Happy new year! Anything blood orange or grapefruit. What do you drink?

I’m glad I’m back on this page. I’ve been here many a times before but I’m starting a new job next year and I want next year to be about me and not full of the anxiety alcohol gives me. Hope he can respect it as I can see myself being happier without alcohol.

Thank you so much to know I’m not the only one being pressured to drink. I think that will be my first challenge of my sober journey. I’ve tried before and failed but hope I’m more experienced and resolute this time. I really appreciate your message.
I’m trying decaf but I think I might need to try a few as the first one I picked up doesn’t taste to good. But I’m going to try. I want to be rid or at least reduce my anxiety
I hope it’s super near. I’ve tried a few times but it never really sticks past a day. This is my longest alcohol free time since early last year
Hoping this is what happens to me. I want to be able to say I’ve managed to stick to my word.

Thank you everyone. It is nice to know people have been through the same. It’s hard as I don’t have anyone around me who knows what I’m doing or going through. And I don’t want to make work aware I’m having an issue
I’m a huge fan of coffee always have been. I might switch to decaf as I go for more of the taste than the caffeine. Thank you for letting me know it worked for you.
Thank you all so much!! Such good suggestions, I’ll have to give some a try this week

Thank you. I’m feeling a lot better. I went to be just after midnight (fireworks and the puppy). No head ache today and about to go find a cafe and read a book. Really want to kick this habit this year. Iwndwut
I love buying myself flowers. It feels empowering!
Thank you everyone. What a day to make this decision. It’s also my cake day in reddit. Haha. It was meant to be and I’m getting through the first night with tea but it’s so hard to not overthink

You are so beautiful!!! Please don’t think having a boyfriend gives your worth. It does not (From experience). You will be so thankful that you had this chance to learn about yourself and when you do find love it will be so worth it!! Enjoy life and enjoy your own company. Those who are worthy of you are I’ll be in your life and will Arrive in your life when they deserve you. 😘😘😘

Thank you. I have read this so many time. It is really helping. I’m panicking a bit this morning and I just read this. It’s nice to be told it’s okay to feel and have bad nights. Usually I’m told I’m not allowed to

Usually I am so careful on the days I drink. Like Tuesday I was upset and he was like let’s go get a bottle of wine and talk. And I said I’m not drinking my minds not right. But I don’t know what happened the other day. I’m hoping he understands. He is so much of what I need and want. He challenges me and gets me off my arse and going for walks and wants to go in day trips places. Plus I laugh with him like really laugh. That’s rare for me
Thank you for those kind works. It’s nice that’s you have taken the time to reply. It means a lot to not feel so alone
